title: OTHRYS OS Switchyard selection preview
goal: Resolve the OS model preference into a deterministic local-first selection preview without invoking any model or granting routing authority.
laws: Selection preview is read-only and deterministic.
Auto prefers available PRIMARY local engineering labor.
Explicit preference may select only an available declared model.
Unavailable or unknown preferences fail closed.
Preview never invokes a model, Worker, Talos or shell.
Remote escalation remains gated and unavailable.
Actual execution routing remains a later mission.

slices.title: Render selection reason beside model selector
